align-workspace-lock.patch.description: Align local package lockfile versions with the 0.163.0 workspace without changing external dependencies.

minimal-runtime-entrypoint.patch.description: Provide the app-server command and protocol generators through a dedicated runtime entrypoint.

require-explicit-model-provider.patch.description: Require an explicit provider without native account fallback

remove-cloud-config.patch.description: Load runtime policy exclusively from local configuration

remove-remote-control.patch.description: Remove remote control transport and protocol registration

disable-native-skills.patch.description: Disable native skill discovery and retain isolation RPC compatibility

remove-native-plugin-marketplace.patch.description: Remove native plugin and marketplace entrypoints and loading

remove-official-apps.patch.description: Remove official Apps RPCs and hosted MCP auto-registration

remove-cloud-history-notes.patch.description: Remove cloud history notes integration and activation

remove-cloud-git-attribution.patch.description: Remove cloud Git attribution policy and extension

provider-scoped-model-catalog.patch.description: Use bundled model metadata unless a provider catalog is explicit

provider-scoped-compaction.patch.description: Require explicit provider support for remote compaction

remove-feedback-upload.patch.description: Remove feedback RPC and network upload transports

remove-analytics-upload.patch.description: Replace analytics queues and senders with an inert instrumentation facade

remove-otel-exporters.patch.description: Remove telemetry exporters and runtime reload workers

remove-managed-account-flows.patch.description: Remove native account lifecycle while retaining provider credential refresh

araceae-executable-names.patch.description: Name the runtime entrypoint and its helper executables with the araceae prefix

araceae-package-layout.patch.description: Name the package resource and PATH directories and the layout manifest with the araceae prefix

araceae-home-directory.patch.description: Default the runtime state directory to ~/.araceae when CODEX_HOME is unset

provider-auth-rejected-token.patch.description: Pass the credential refused with HTTP 401 to provider auth command refreshes as ARACEAE_PROVIDER_AUTH_REJECTED_TOKEN

platform-error-envelope.patch.description: Recognize configured HTTP 2xx {code, reason, message} gateway error envelopes as refused credentials or terminal request errors

subagent-model-lock.patch.description: Keep spawned subagents on the parent model and reasoning effort when agents.lock_subagent_model is set

application-context-world-state.patch.description: Render application additionalContext as one replaceable world-state developer message limited to 10,000 estimated tokens

apply-patch-function-tool.patch.description: Offer apply_patch as a JSON function tool selected by apply_patch_tool_type, which also applies to fallback model metadata

raw-usage-notifications.patch.description: Deliver rawResponse/completed usage notifications without the raw-events opt-in, including resumed threads

chat-wire-api.patch.description: Speak the Chat Completions wire protocol for providers with wire_api = "chat", configured by [model_providers.<id>.chat]
